unary: Shared family H96 and E128 from the existing node descriptors and context summaries
edge: For each unordered family pair: original36 raw and36 context-adjusted correlation-change descriptors, restricted to edges connecting the two families
probability: Conditional binary graphical model: sum unary_f*y_f plus sum pair_fg*y_f*y_g; enumerate all family states; risk=sum probability where active family count>=2
supervision: Marginal log likelihood of observed future family statuses; reference-ineligible families fixed to0; unknown statuses marginalized
constant_coupling: One shared learned pair intercept without network descriptors
conditional_graph: Same pair intercept plus shared additive spline function of72 pair descriptors
selection: Existing validation participant fold AUROC; no exposed test used for tuning
weighting: Equal person; each origin log likelihood divided by number of known family targets
primary_comparison: conditional graph against independent and constant coupling on identical origins
scope: Development only; original HNE-additive comparisons retained
prior_art: Conditional random fields and count potentials are established; contribution assessed here is shared reference-relative H/N/E factorization for future family disturbance across schemas.
